jobs.title: Projektreferent*in Vernetzung & Narrative
jobs.reason: The role asks for a relevant degree (politics among them) and lists project-management and process-coordination experience as fundamental ("fundierte Erfahrung"), which the candidate only partly meets through RA and funding-allocation work — a real soft obstacle, though not a strict multi-year disqualifier. It centres on environmental/civil-society volunteer coordination, communications and event facilitation, which sits outside the candidate's core interest zones and taps their weaker comms/events area. Eligible but a marginal fit on both level and interest.

jobs.title: Programmmanager (m/w/d) Beratung - Hochschulforum Digitalisierung
jobs.reason: Entry-adjacent with an explicit Master's requirement and only "first professional experience" asked, so it is not gated on level — and the candidate's German Rectors' Conference funding-allocation and higher-education research work map directly onto this HE-digital-transformation programme role. However, the job centres on consulting, stakeholder moderation, workshop design and project management (areas where the candidate is thinner) and sits in higher-education policy, adjacent to rather than inside the core international-law / security interest zones, which caps the score.
jobs.salary: Not specified (13th salary, holiday pay, occupational pension mentioned)

jobs.title: Mitarbeiter*in (m/w/d) für Office Management und Veranstaltungsorganisation
jobs.reason: This is an office-management and events-organisation administrative post, not a research role; it asks for a completed commercial apprenticeship or comparable qualification and is essentially a service/logistics function that the candidate can do but which underuses their research profile and matches their limited events experience only partially. Although the Centre Marc Bloch is a Franco-German social-sciences institute (mild adjacent interest), the day-to-day work is administrative and outside the candidate's core mission, so it rates low.

jobs.title: Partnermanager (m/w/d) Hochschulen im KI-Campus
jobs.reason: The profile makes at least three years of relevant professional experience an essential requirement, which the candidate — with only student-assistant and RA work — does not meet. The higher-education-policy field and the candidate's prior Stifterverband-adjacent experience are a genuine topical fit, but the experience bar is a hard disqualifier, and it is a partner-management/networking role rather than research.
jobs.salary: Not specified (13th salary, holiday pay, occupational pension mentioned)
